header: Clearing of forensic evidence from event logs using wevtutil
content:
// Look for use of wevtutil to clear multiple logs
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where ProcessCommandLine has "WEVTUTIL" and ProcessCommandLine has "CL"
| summarize LogClearCount = dcount(ProcessCommandLine), ClearedLogList =
make_set(ProcessCommandLine) by DeviceId, bin(Timestamp, 5m)
| where LogClearCount > 10
